subject: Oddity with use of plyr::summarize inside reactive

messages.author: c8fe4075ec631c03
messages.subject: Oddity with use of plyr::summarize inside reactive
parts:
Hi Guys,

  When I use plyr::summarize inside a reactive I get (in only some environments) an error which suggests it's using HHMisc's summarize instead.

  This doesn't happen on my desktop, just when I deploy to production on linux (eek).

  I haven't managed to override this - might it be related to the environment provided to the reactive?

-Alex

messages.author: d34d025a513c07fc
messages.subject: Re: Oddity with use of plyr::summarize inside reactive
parts:
This is an unfortunate consequence of the two packages having functions with the same name. The order in which the packages are loaded will determine which one you get.

The easy way to avoir it is to use the British spelling for the plyr version: 'summarise', instead of 'summarize'.

-Winston
